item.title: Tarique Rahman frontrunner for PM post: The Economist

item.title: Sherpur Jamaat candidate Nuruzzaman Badal dies
item.description: Jamaat-e-Islami Sherpur district secretary and candidate for Sherpur-3 (Sreebordi-Jhenaigati) constituency Md Nuruzzaman Badal passed away early Wednesday.He breathed his last at a hospital in Mymensingh at about 2AM, confirmed Hafizur Rahman, chief of the Sherpur district Jamaat.Jamaat-e-Islami also confirmed the death news on its official Facebook page.Hafizur Rahman said, Nuruzzaman Badal, 51, had been suffering from kidney disease for a long time. item.title: Russia launches ‘most powerful’ blitz on Ukraine’s energy sector
item.description: Russia launched the “most powerful” attack so far this year on Ukraine’s battered energy facilities overnight, Kyiv said on Tuesday, leaving hundreds of thousands without heating in glacial temperatures ahead of talks to end the four-year war.Russia’s strikes hit as temperatures dropped to their lowest since the start of the war in February 2022 and damaged an iconic Soviet-era WWII monument. item.title: 'Prevent cancer before it starts': new WHO study maps risks
item.description: A new WHO study suggests more than 7 million cases of cancer in 2022 were preventable. item.title: Turkey ready to mediate between Iran and US: Erdogan
item.description: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan stressed on Tuesday that his country was prepared to mediate between Iran and the US to ease tensions between them, warning against any step that may spark war in the region.Erdogan arrived in Riyadh on an official visit on Tuesday. item.title: Mardaani 3 box office collection day 5: Rani Mukerji film nears Rs 25cr in India
item.description: After adding up the collections of all five days, Mardaani 3 stands at Rs 22.25 crore.Rani Mukerji's Mardaani 3 was released in theatres on January 30.
